title: Storm Dragon Scales: The Storm Caller
summary: Uncover the Storm Caller by advancing the climb and entering the gust of wind.
overview: Uncover the Storm Caller by advancing the climb and entering the gust of wind.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Consolidate the group before approaching the new gust.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Thirty qualifying deaths reveal the gust trigger.
Entering its proximity spawns the Storm Caller and four Ascent storms at their fixed locations.
Prepare for both the caller and the nearby storm enemies before advancing the trigger.

notes: Approval E327. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
